review.explanation: The sentence describes giving flowers on a mother's birthday. あげました (gave) directly matches the context of presenting flowers as a gift. かしました (bought) implies purchasing but not the act of giving. ならいました (became) and かぶりました (wore) are semantically unrelated to flower-giving. The N5 level requires basic verbs, and あげました is foundational.
